MVLA Board of Trustees · Area 3 · November 2026
# Experience that keeps MVLA improving.
Re-elect Catherine Vonnegut, the longest-serving trustee on the board, to keep our high schools focused on strong academics, sound finances, safe campuses, and student wellness.
Endorse Catherine → See her record

Why I'm asking for your vote
## A simple foundation, held steady for eight years.
My commitment to MVLA students, families, and staff comes down to four things I work toward at every board meeting.
01
### Excellent academics
Strong instruction for every student, including CTE pathways, alternative options, and teaching methods that lift those who need more support.
02
### Fiscal responsibility
Careful stewardship of public dollars, from the $290M Measure E bond to the everyday budgets that keep classrooms running.
03
### Safe schools
Campuses where students and staff are protected, with upgraded facilities, infrastructure, and emergency preparedness.
04
### Student wellness
Wellness areas at high schools and a Multi-Tiered System of Support that meets students, and staff, where they are.
## Catherine at Work for MVLA Students
‹ ›
Homecoming with Dr. Meyer Foundation 40th Birthday Lunch at LAHS visiting MVHS classroom Touring construction at MVHS Student Services celebrating opening of Medassist in Mountain View Madrigals perform at MVLA staff holiday lunch
The record · Two terms of work
## Eight years of decisions that moved our schools forward.
As my dad always said, everything can benefit from iterative refinement. Here is the work I have advocated for, term by term.
2022 – 2026 Current term Now the longest-serving member on the board
#### Built out Career & Technical Education
Hired a CTE coordinator to establish more CTE strands and partner with the community on real-world learning options.
#### Established wellness centers at both high schools
Continuously addressing the mental-health needs of students and staff using the Multi-Tiered System of Support (MTSS) model.
#### Substantially completed the $290M Measure E bond
Finished major construction across both campuses and voted to update high school gyms with remaining bond and other funds.
#### Gave students a real voice
Established the Student Superintendent Advisory Committee and Student Principal advisory committees at LAHS and MVHS.
#### Adopted "Constructing Meaning" instruction
A teaching method that helps all students, and especially those who need more support, reach their full learning potential.
#### Steadied the district through major change
Helped welcome new superintendents, principals, and directors while keeping the focus on students.
2018 – 2022 First term Calm, consistent leadership through COVID
#### Guided MVLA through COVID
Calm, consistent, collaborative action, with MVLA procedures other districts adopted as models of effective management.
#### Made the online option permanent
Kept Option B as a permanent program for students and families who need it, now a statewide model program.
#### Expanded access and options
Doubled the Middle College program, added English Learner classes at LAHS, and broadened CTE and alternative pathways.
#### Upgraded facilities and fields
Completed classrooms with Measure E funds, revamped fields, added lights at MVHS and LAHS, and began new student-services and Freestyle Academy buildings.
#### Closed the digital divide
Upgraded network and school infrastructure, plus heating, air conditioning, filtering, and campus-safety equipment.
Read more about the last 8 years and my advocacy (PDF) →
## 40+ Years Supporting Public Schools in Mountain View and Los Altos
Hover over or tap a column to pause it.
I HAVE BEEN THERE FOR PUBLIC EDUCATION
- I volunteered with students at old MVHS downtown, programming Z80 computers during study hall, over 40 years ago.
- I served on facility and budget committees in MVWSD.
- I was on the MV Education Foundation board as auditor and first webmaster.
- I was a PTA, PTA Council, or PTA County officer or school site council member/chair ALL years of my son’s K-12 experience.
- As PTA Council President, I was FIRST to invite the MVLA superintendent to PTA Council to share about MVLA.
- I encouraged and chartered the MVHS PTSA and LAHS PTSA as PTA Council president.
- I was the FIRST MVHS PTSA president.
- I wrote emergency prep materials that hang on the walls of every classroom in MVLA.
- I designed updated, more comprehensive emergency drill procedures for MVLA, now standard, and facilitated CB antenna installation at the District office.
- I wrote software to schedule parent-teacher conferences more efficiently.
- I consulted to MVLA in IT.
- I served on the Adult School advisory committee for over 15 years.
- I have served with calm, collaboration, and compromise on the Board of Trustees for the last 8 years.
I WANT TO BE HERE FOR 4 MORE YEARS WHEN…
- Keeping in mind excellent academics, great facilities, attention to physical wellness and safety and mental health — in a fiscally responsible way.
- MVLA iteratively refines use of MTSS (Multi-Tiered System of Support) for academics and student wellbeing.
- MVLA navigates the changing AI landscape (my master’s in computer science helps with this understanding).
- MVLA works with all trustees, staff, and community members with differing thoughts on alignment to produce measurable change and outcomes.
My background
## A problem solver who has shown up for our schools for four decades.
"I am honored to have been elected in 2018 and re-elected in 2022. As the longest-serving member of the current board, I bring historical perspective, institutional knowledge, and a genuine commitment to continuous improvement."
— Catherine Vonnegut
Education and public schools have been my focus for over 40 years, from volunteering in classrooms to leadership in PTAs, School Site Councils, and district committees across Mountain View Whisman and MVLA. I would be honored to have your vote again in 2026.
- 8 years as MVLA Trustee, the longest-serving current member; past President, Vice President, and Clerk.
- Retired software engineer and manager, with an MS in Computer Science and BS in Mathematics from Purdue University.
- Former Red Cross EMT and instructor, teaching CPR, first aid, and emergency response for 40+ years.
- 40+ years of volunteer and leadership roles across MVLA, MVWSD, and PTA at every level.
- Founder of Choral Fest and past President of the MVHS PTSA and the Los Altos Mountain View PTA Council.
- Mountain View resident and homeowner since 1977, with one adult son who graduated from MVHS.
More details about my background (PDF) →
Understanding the new area elections
## This year, I am on the ballot in Area 3.
MVLA has moved to area-based elections. There are five areas, and only one trustee is elected per area. The 2026 election fills the seats for Areas 1, 2, and 3.
I live in Area 3, and so do Thida Cornes and Sanjay Dave who are also running for this seat. Your endorsement is valued whether or not you live in my area, because your word carries weight in our community.

Vonnegut key endorsements for 2026


This is a nonpartisan position. I support ALL students and the ENTIRE community, not favoring or making
decisions on other than school and education based criteria. I make decisions based on information from
community, the school staff, and my own research with calm, collaborative compromise on what will be best for
the students and our district. I have not and will not seek endorsement from any political party, religious group,
union or other organization. Certainly, I hope individuals from any of those groups endorse me.

Notice that both Trustees that serviced with me for prior 4 years and with Sanjay for 6 years endorsed me
(Fiona Walter and Debbie Torok),as well as endorsement from Steve Hope, Former/retired MVLA associaate
superintendent HR who worked with me when I did emergency prep and IT for MVLA as a volunteer and
consultant.

"Catherine's eight years of experience on the MVLA board combined with her tireless dedication to
every student's success make her an ideal candidate to continue for the next four years. She knows
the team, knows the district, and knows the issues. She will serve our community well." - Fiona
Walter

Statement fromTrustee Elisabeth Halliday from Campbell UHSD:"I’m proud to endorse Catherine Vonnegut for
the Mountain View–Los Altos High School District Board. Catherine brings the experience, knowledge, and
preparation that strong school board governance requires. I especially value her thoughtful, unbiased approach
and her commitment to serving each and every student, recognizing that trustees have a responsibility to
represent all students and families in their district. Experienced, prepared, knowledgeable, and student-
centered, Catherine is exactly the kind of leader I value in public education." - Elisabeth Halliday
